name: Harbor
summary: Cool blue-grey neutrals with a saturated blue accent and generous 12px corners. Written for Inter, which this package does not load.

do: Use blue for actions and links only, so blue always means clickable.
Keep cards on the white surface over the tinted canvas.
Use 12px corners on cards and buttons alike.
dont: Don't use blue for decoration, such as icons that do nothing.
Don't ship this style without loading Inter if the design depends on its exact widths.

provenance.author: Neat Labs
provenance.evidence: Written for this repository on 2026-09-25. Colors and rules are original. Inter is named as the intended face but is not bundled or loaded.
